description: LongTerMemory is an AI-driven study platform designed to help students and professionals master complex subjects through active recall and spaced repetition. By uploading notes, slides, or photos of textbook pages, users can transform static materials into interactive knowledge bases. The AI analyzes these documents to generate personalized [study plans like flashcards and question-answer](https://longtermemory.com/b/best-flashcard-apps-pdf/) sets tailored to specific learning goals.
